thread:
jun: CI red on canary image push to our internal registry during finalize. 3/5 push attempts failed with a 504 from registry-proxy. No other errors in build, just stalls on finalize. Anyone seen this pattern?

ci-bot: Build #8241 failed: docker push step failed. logs: https://ci.internal/builds/8241 (artifacts attached)

maya: can you paste the push log snippet? also did anything touch the Dockerfile or the registry proxy config recently? :eyes:

jun: here's the snippet from the job (kaniko):
```
Pushing manifest for tag: canary
Uploading layer sha256:abcd...
POST /v2/myorg/canary/blobs/uploads/ HTTP/1.1
Host: registry.internal
< HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Time-out
error: failed to upload blob: unexpected EOF during chunked upload
```
No registry or proxy config changes on our side that I'm aware of; small Dockerfile tweak earlier today (swapped base image layer ordering).

sam: 504 from the proxy on finalize (multipart/complete) smells like either proxy timeouts under S3 backend latency or a chunk alignment issue causing retries to fail. do we have S3 latency spikes in that window?

ops-bot: tagging @eng-infra for visibility. Recommend: 1) rerun with --no-cache/kaniko --reproducible=false to avoid cached layers; 2) bisect the commit range if rerun still flakes; 3) collect proxy logs for the exact upload id.

maya: i'll volunteer to run the bisect if you give me the commit range. also please attach the full kaniko args and env (we need to reproduce exact upload flow).

jun: commit range is: 0f1a2b3..9e8f7d6 (includes that Dockerfile reorder). build id 8241. kaniko args: `--cache=true --cache-dir=/cache --destination=registry.internal/myorg/canary:canary-8241`

sam: quick repro checklist: rerun with `--cache=false` first; if it still 504s, ask platform to tail proxy logs for that upload id and check backend S3 5xx/slow responses. also check if our multipart chunk size changed after the base image reorder (that could change alignment).

maya: i'll kick a rerun now with `--cache=false` and `CANARY_DEBUG=1`. holding off merges into that branch for next 30m. i'll post results. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

jun: thanks maya — if it still flakes, please do the bisect. i'll collect proxy logs and open an infra incident if we see correlated 5xx spikes.

maya: rerun queued (job 8241-rerun-1). will update in ~5m.

sam: adding another quick check — if kaniko retries do partial chunk re-upload, registry might reject finalization with 409/504. if rerun succeeds with no-cache we should invalidate the cache on builder hosts.

jun: noted. leaving cache prune task in the pipeline once we confirm. thanks all :thumbsup:
